title: ProcessStatusOutput
description: Output of `gentry process status --json`: the state of the process on this machine, as known without the network.

remote.description: Address of the remote repository; absent if none is connected.

synced.description: Time of the last successful synchronization in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds; absent if there was none.

drafts.description: Kinds whose directory differs from the active variant.

unsent.description: Kinds changed by commits the remote repository does not have yet; empty without a remote repository.

conflicts.description: Kinds in conflict: the variants of another machine are in their conflict directory.
